notes: An analysis of the expenses made on prison inmates in the various States/UTs reveal that
maximum amount was spent mainly on providing Food for inmates. Uttar Pradesh (932.86 lakhs),
Tamil Nadu (625 lakhs) and Orissa (482.15 lakhs) spent a larger quantum of their resources under this
head. The expense incurred on this account by other states was Rajasthan (286.15 lakhs), Tripura
(36.13 lakhs), Delhi (116.00 lakhs), Andaman & Nicobar Island (10.5) lakhs and Dadra & Nagar Haveli
Under ‘Clothing’, Maharashtra had to spend 30 lakhs for the prison inmates during the year
under review. The other states who had to earmark a reasonable provision for expenses in this head
is Orissa (18.73 lakhs), Manipur (11.79 lakhs), Bihar (11.7 lakhs), Manipur (5 lakhs), Tamil Nadu (4
lakhs), Jammu & Kashmir (1.73 lakhs), Andaman & Nicobar Island (1.10 lakhs), Tripura (0.92 lakhs)
